narrative.details:
adventurer, Melor Stonehoof has heard of your deeds, and has set a path before you.

If you wish to take it, then go to Thunder Bluff and speak with Melor.  You will find him on Hunter's Rise.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.
narrative.offerRewardText:
So, adventurer, you have come. Now, are you prepared to journey through distant lands?

If so, young Champion, then listen on...
